tasks.title: File storage, upload scanning and system email

tasks.title: PII store and vault core
tasks.goal: Buyer PII can be stored, read for a logged purpose, masked and searched, and nothing outside the vault ever holds it.
scope: packages/pii-db migrations: PII records keyed by pii_ref (uuidv7) and workspace_id, with kind (DP-5 list only), channel_account_id, subject refs (order or conversation ID), buyer key, delete_after, created_at; blind-index table; tombstones table; access log (who, capability, purpose, pii_ref, time; never values)

Field encryption AES-256-GCM with a per-workspace data key wrapped by the PII master key (pii-vault's Docker secret only); reuse packages/crypto; a separate per-workspace index key for blind indexes (HMAC-SHA256 of normalised postcode, email, phone, name)

Capability service tokens per caller (web, worker): ingest, read-full (purpose required: label, order_detail, inbox; logged), mask, search, match (same-buyer order IDs only, ADR-055), delete (deletion service only); a caller without the capability gets 403
Every request carries the workspace; the vault refuses a pii_ref from another workspace (404)
Masked values computed on request, never stored (ORD-5 shape)
Typed vault client in packages, used by web and worker; web and worker never get db-pii credentials (dependency-cruiser rule)
Memory and pool limits as in ARCHITECTURE (vault 4 connections)
acceptance: Tests first, citing IDs: ciphertext only in db-pii (a raw SQL read shows no plaintext marker); wrong capability 403; cross-workspace pii_ref 404; every read-full and search writes an access-log row with no value; a blind-index search finds a normalised match
PII marker scan (AT-9 harness) finds no marker in db-main, logs or job tables after an ingest and read cycle
CI full gate green at merge

tasks.title: Deletion service with every trigger

scope: One deletion service in the vault (delete capability) with entry points for all seven DEL-1 triggers; triggers whose modules do not exist yet (orders, channel accounts, Amazon) get the entry point and a test through it, and are wired when their module lands
Hourly expiry job (worker, ID-only payload) deleting records past delete_after; the caller sets delete_after at ingest or update (delivery or dispatch + pii_expiry_days, default 25)
Hard DELETE then VACUUM; tombstones in db-pii, in db-main (IDs only) and in an off-site journal file (a local directory standing in for B2)
Run log (time, trigger, scope counts and IDs, result; never values) and a deletion certificate per channel account (admin download)
User deletion also hard-deletes that user's app.terms_acceptances rows (ADR-058b)
Hook for label files (deleted at the earlier of 30 days or PII expiry); labels arrive in M12
Idempotent: a re-run deletes nothing twice and logs zero
out_of_scope: Erasure and access request screens (T-0404, T-0308)
acceptance: Tests first, citing IDs: each trigger deletes only its scope; after deletion even the db-pii owner role finds no row; tombstones written in all three places; the run log holds no value (marker scan); expiry deletes at day 25 and not at day 24
Halfway checkpoint (S4) after this task

tasks.title: Fixes from the external audit (ADR-069)
tasks.goal: Deletions are complete, jobs never run ahead of their data, and the eBay key budget and PII backups hold under abuse and outages.
scope: A-001: eBay user match pages through every matching record and queues every batch before the 200; no silent LIMIT in a deletion path
A-002: jobs enqueued from a request use the request's transaction (every notifier call); test delivery at the commit boundary
A-003: limiter counts before any key fetch; unknown key IDs negative-cached 1 h; global cap on uncached key fetches per minute
A-004: db-pii snapshots older than 3 days by their own time are forgotten regardless of count; test with a long backup gap
A-005: db-pii pool and client error handlers as db-main; recovery test after a terminated connection
A-006 server side: erasure request states completed and failed set from the deletion job outcome; overdue until completed; retry route re-queues a failed request (admin only, audited)
acceptance: Tests first, each citing an ID, reproducing Astra's proof: 5,001 matches all deleted; job not visible before commit; 501 unknown-key requests spend at most the cap; a 40-day gap leaves no snapshot older than 3 days; vault survives a terminated connection; a failed job leaves the request failed and overdue
PR lists each A- ID with its test
CI full gate green at merge
